name: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
feeMethod: Sets undergraduate tuition by group of majors (Engineering, Business, Chemistry & Life Sciences, base rate), so the calculator uses the group rate. Master's use their programme's rate.
description: The University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign is the flagship public research university of the State of Illinois, founded in 1867. It is known for its Grainger College of Engineering, computer science and Gies College of Business.
whyIncluded: In 2009 UIUC launched the Advanced Digital Sciences Centre at Fusionopolis with A*STAR, its first research centre outside the United States.

livingCosts.summary: Illinois's own estimate for an international undergraduate in a campus residence hall with a meal plan, over the academic year: housing, food, books and other costs. Excludes tuition, fees and insurance.
livingCosts.notes: 2026-27 undergraduate estimated additional expenses, non-resident/international column: food & housing $15,858 (traditional double room with air, Classic meal plan; combined, so all in housing, food 0); books & supplies $1,200 + other $2,840 (transportation, clothing, recreation and miscellaneous; transport not split out, so in personal). Months not stated; academic year taken as 9 months.

programmes.name: Accountancy, MSA
programmes.feeBasis: Gies's 2026-27 estimate of international MSA tuition for summer, fall and spring (US$54,352), plus the registrar's campus fees for those terms without the waivable health insurance (US$4,696).
programmes.feeChoice: The school's estimate for the summer, fall and spring terms covers the whole 12-month degree.
programmes.summary: Tuition for international students on Gies's 12-month on-campus MS in Accountancy (summer, fall and spring), plus campus fees and the international student fee. Health insurance not included. STEM-designated.
programmes.notes: Gies 'MSA Tuition & Scholarships' page, 2026-27 estimates for international students: Summer '26 $10,700 + Fall '26 $21,826 + Spring '27 $21,826 = tuition $54,352; Campus Fees $1,981 + $2,847 + $2,847 = $7,675 (total $62,027). The 12-month programme spans three terms, so the whole total is recorded as one year. Campus fees replaced 2026-10-15: Gies's campus-fee line includes the waivable student health insurance (its $2,847 fall figure is the registrar's Fall 2025 Range I total $2,769 incl. $1,088 insurance, plus the $78 international fee), which the schema excludes. Compulsory now = registrar graduate campus fees, Range I (12+ hours; 9+ in summer), minus the Health Insurance Fee, plus the International Student Fee per term: 2026-27 = Summer 2026 ($2,116 - $1,088 + $78 = $1,106, registrar.illinois.edu/tuition-fees/tuition-fee-rates/tf-rates-term/g-fees-su26/) + Fall 2026 and Spring 2027 (2 x ($2,840 - $1,125 + $80) = $3,590, .../g-fees-cr-2627/) = $4,696; 2025-26 = Summer 2025 ($2,056 - $1,051 + $76 = $1,081, registrar.illinois.edu/g-fees-su25/) + 2 x ($2,769 - $1,088 + $78) = $3,518 (g-fees-cr-2526) = $4,599; 2024-25 = Summer 2024 ($2,012 - $1,008 + $75 = $1,079, g-fees-su24) + 2 x ($2,697 - $1,051 + $76) = $3,444 (g-fees-cr-2425) = $4,523. Gies's own campus-fee totals (with insurance) were $7,675 (2026-27), $7,675 (2025-26) and $7,481 (2024-25). History from Common Crawl captures of the same Gies page (earlier URL giesbusiness.illinois.edu/msa/tuition): 2024-25 tuition $10,490 + $20,979 + $20,979 = $52,448, campus fees $7,481; 2025-26 tuition $53,496 ($10,700 + $21,398 + $21,398), campus fees $7,675. The cheaper Master of Accounting Science (MAS, listed in the registrar rate table) requires a US accounting bachelor's, so MSA was chosen for international applicants. Not cohort-locked.
